instrument: float32 inference; unit-drive baselines; DrivAerML surface pressure rel-L2, 48 validation cars, 10,000 cells; seed means

columns.in_family: pressure rel-L2 on the 48 validation cars (sampling uniform over cells, 10k)
columns.density_factor: pressure rel-L2 under 10:1 front/back Poisson-biased sampling (exact HT measure weights) ÷ uniform, 10k cells, float32; SAMPLE FRAME for every row (the input frame centred on the drawn points, as a biased mesher delivers it; probes drivaer_probe_{unif2,biased3}_sf); pool-frame values (pipeline centring on the uniform reader pool before the draw) are kept per row where they differ
columns.pose_factor: pressure rel-L2 with every training and validation case in its own random SO(3) pose ÷ canonical-pose error of the same architecture (POSE-BENCH, research/transfer_program/studies/campaign_b_pose/campaign_b_fp32_2026-09-10.json); baselines trained with SO(3) augmentation
columns.zero_shot_fastback: pressure rel-L2 on the 99 SHIFT-SUV fastback validation cases, no fastback training data (1.0 = predicting the mean; transfer session float32 evaluations under snapshot code)
columns.few_shot_gain: fine-tuned on 20 fastback cases for 1,000 steps at matched learning rate: error from scratch ÷ error fine-tuned − 1 (campaign C T3, #sec-nb-campc-t3-verdict)

isla_reference_constant_gauge.label: ISLA, constant gauge (reference, lr 1e-3)
isla_reference_constant_gauge.density_note: ISLA centres in the model on the sampled points, so pool-frame and sample-frame probes agree within 1% (sample-frame rerun: constant 11.99, gauge 1.207, weights-off 19.23)

isla_similarity_gauge.density_note: ISLA centres in the model on the sampled points, so pool-frame and sample-frame probes agree within 1% (sample-frame rerun: constant 11.99, gauge 1.207, weights-off 19.23)

isla_weights_off_ablation.label: ISLA, measure weights off (ablation, not adopted; lr 1e-3)
